summary.text: Lee Deming is a Republican member of the Montana House of Representatives from District 54, where Ballotpedia lists his tenure as beginning in 2023, and an educator with Laurel Public Schools seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Janine Coole.

paragraphs.text: Deming was born in Helena, Montana, and lives in Laurel.

He graduated from Helena High School in 1974, earned a bachelor's degree in social science from Carroll College in 1978, and earned a master's degree in educational leadership and administration from the University of Montana in 1987.
His career experience includes working as an educator with Laurel Public Schools.
In the 2025-2026 session Deming was assigned to the Fish, Wildlife and Parks, Legislative Administration, Education and Judiciary committees, serving as vice chair of the Judiciary Committee.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026.
